auth.ldap.title: LDAP / Active Directory
auth.ldap.help: Users sign in with their directory user name and password (also usable for the API). Settings are stored in config.yaml (plugin_settings).
auth.ldap.insecure: Do not verify the TLS certificate (test setups only)
auth.ldap.attr_subject_help: e.g. entryUUID or objectGUID. Empty: the DN is used.
auth.ldap.group_attribute: Group attribute in the user entry
auth.ldap.ca_cert_help: Certificate of an internal certificate authority that signed the LDAP server certificate (PEM text or a file path). Safer than switching the check off.
